prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1026; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was riding in the front passenger seat of my sister's car. We were stopped at a light in Pasadena, Texas, on the main road near the shopping center.

Q: Can you describe what happened right before the impact?

A: We had been stopped for a few seconds, maybe longer. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind. The car lurched forward, and I braced myself against the dashboard with my right arm.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: No, I was looking ahead at the light. I only saw it in the side mirror after the impact, a pickup truck with its front end pushed into our back bumper.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I had it on the whole time.

Q: Tell me about your injuries.

A: My right wrist hit the dashboard and I felt a sharp pain right away. They took me to the emergency room, and the X-rays showed a fracture. The doctor put me in a cast and said I'd need a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Have you had any other symptoms since the collision?

A: My neck was stiff for a couple of days, and I had some soreness in my shoulder, but the wrist is the worst of it. I can't grip anything well right now.

Q: Did you speak with the driver of the other vehicle at the scene?

A: Briefly. He apologized and said he had been looking at his phone for a moment. Then the police arrived and took our information.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to this statement?

A: No, I think that covers it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
